About

 

SJSU Magazine: Fall 2026 Issue

The fall issue of SJSU Magazine showcases a number of examples of the competitive Spartan Edge — ranging from Connie L. Lurie College of Education’s renewed commitment to neurodiversity-affirming teaching to Moss Landing Marine Laboratories researchers studying environmental change in the Arctic.

Dive In

Designer: Veronica Brooks, '27 Art History & Visual Culture

Native American & Indigenous Heritage Month 2026

This November, San José State University honors the rich histories, diverse cultures, and lasting contributions of Native American and Indigenous peoples.

Apply to SJSU for Fall 2027

Domestic first-year and transfer applicants: submit your Fall 2027 Cal State Apply application by Nov. 30. Different deadlines apply to international and graduate applicants.

Review Deadlines and Apply

Imagine Yourself Here

Why Choose SJSU?

San José State provides a world-class education—whether courses are online or in person. The university is expanding the ways we provide high-quality education and unique research and hands-on experiences to students.

SJSU Online and Professional Education

Choose from over 50 SJSU online, hybrid, or in-person undergraduate, graduate, and non-degree programs and gain a real-world edge.

SJSU Magazine

SJSU Magazine serves as SJSU's university and alumni magazine, sharing compelling and inspiring stories that embody the Spartan pride and resilience we all treasure.

Explore our Interactive Map

Discover all San José State University campuses with a brand-new engaging and interactive campus map.

View Interactive Map
